host_inspection.blocker_analysis: /proc/<pid> ABSENT for both PIDs (43 and 37 pids visible in the container namespace). ps cannot see them. The allocations are therefore outside this container's PID namespace -- host-level or another container on the shared physical machine. They cannot be terminated from here, and ownership cannot be established. Refused to act, per the standing safety rule.

single_gpu_residency_test.result: weights loaded, then FAILED allocating the 512 MiB KV cache
single_gpu_residency_test.error: ggml_backend_cuda_buffer_type_alloc_buffer: allocating 512.00 MiB on device 0: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
single_gpu_residency_test.conclusion: Stronger than the earlier torch OOM: the weights alone nearly fit (7576 of 7786 MiB), but the working set (weights + 512 MiB KV) cannot. The model cannot be GPU-resident.

cpu_offload_baseline.note: cold = first run; warm = model in page cache

distributed_baseline.note: network cost is model-independent (~453 ms/token), so Q8_0 distributed would be similar or worse

verdict.distributed_capacity: claim proven (model cannot be GPU-resident on any GPU)
verdict.practical_advantage_over_cpu_offload: NONE for this model. Single machine with 2 layers offloaded runs 58 tok/s warm; three-host distributed runs 2.2 tok/s. CPU offload is ~26x faster.
verdict.why: two WAN hops at ~310 ms each dominate; three GPUs of 6-8 GB cannot outrun one machine with 62 GB RAM.
